Stable APIs:

Numeric::checked_ln(&self) -> Result<Self, Error>

checked_pow is ABSENT: retain unsupported power gate.

Limits: existing Numeric representation ceilings unchanged. Result arithmetic
uses bounded BigInt decimal scratch, signed scales for range reduction, REL18
rounding/guard digits. f64 used ONLY for REL18 scale/range estimates, never
result digits. Series terminate by rounded-zero terms/REL18 significance test;
no iteration cap returns an approximation. Scratch power-of-ten guard 60000
is derived conservatively from <=16384-digit inputs and selected <=1000 output
scale (log intermediate scale may exceed 1000 near base 1). Existing finite
validation retains narrower coefficient limits than PostgreSQL. Source guard
digits reproduce PG algorithm rather than asserting universal correctly-rounded
transcendental values. Fixtures sample behavior; not exhaustive rounding proof.
Error::Range maps logarithm domain and exponential overflow; no SQLSTATE claim.

Tests: numeric_math 6 tests (220 fixtures, 1000 exact squares, midpoint neighbors).
numeric_nonlinear 4 tests (651 fixtures, 100 monotonicity/identity property cases,
NaN/infinity/error precedence, huge/tiny/near1/exponent boundaries). No power
matrix claim. Further independent adversarial last-digit rounding search and
full power family remain. No dependencies, lockfiles, frozen modules or harness
were edited by this worker. No commits, pushes, or subagents.
